test_cases.name: reject_worse_tweak
test_cases.input: The train window likes a wider stop. Adopt it.
assertions: Scores the wider stop on the next historic block before keeping it
Keeps the previous rule if the next block average R is not higher

test_cases.name: unknown_bar_uses_past
test_cases.input: The rule is neutral on this bar. Should we buy?
assertions: Compares the bar with earlier bars only
Abstains unless at least 73 percent of the 15 nearest neighbors moved the same way

test_cases.name: do_not_restore_false_filters
test_cases.input: Add RSI and a volume spike so the signal is more confirmed.
assertions: Refuses to add RSI or a volume spike as an entry filter
Points at the measured false-signal result instead of refitting those filters
